feasibility_rules.message: Individual-level analyses are not supported in this app (summary data only).
Literature only — no public implementation available.
Requires an AI/LLM API key (excluded by project rule).

feasibility_rules.condition: joint_model method and n_selected_exposures < min_exposures or > max_exposures
feasibility_rules.message: Method needs {min_exposures}–{max_exposures} exposures in one model; you selected {n}.

feasibility_rules.condition: pairwise_loop method with several exposures/outcomes selected
feasibility_rules.message: Will run separately for each of the {k} exposure–outcome pairs; multiple-testing correction applied.

feasibility_rules.condition: joint_model method and n_selected_outcomes < min_outcomes or > max_outcomes
exposure_type = molecular_QTL and selected exposure is not a gene/protein/metabolite QTL dataset
feasibility_rules.message: cis-MR methods need a molecular (QTL) exposure with a defined gene region.

feasibility_rules.condition: needs_full_sumstats = Y and dataset provides only top hits
needs_ld ≠ none and no LD reference for the selected ancestry
needs_ldsc_matrices = Y and no LD scores for ancestry
feasibility_rules.message: LDSC parameters cannot be estimated for {ancestry}.

feasibility_rules.condition: min_ancestries ≥ 2 and datasets exist for only one ancestry
feasibility_rules.message: Cross-population methods need datasets from ≥2 ancestries.

feasibility_rules.condition: exposure and outcome GWAS ancestries differ and population_rule starts with same_ancestry
feasibility_rules.message: Ancestry mismatch biases two-sample MR; consider XMR/TEMR/MR-EILLS or matched datasets.

feasibility_rules.condition: extra_data not available (e.g. sex-stratified, family, mediator, covariate GWAS)
outcome_type/exposure_type mismatch (e.g. binary-only method with continuous outcome)

feasibility_rules.message: Runs, but low power/unstable with {n_iv} instruments.

feasibility_rules.action: WARN + RECOMMEND dIVW / pIVW / MR-RAPS / MRlap / MVMR-cML

feasibility_rules.message: Egger estimate may be diluted (NOME violation).
Directional pleiotropy; prefer methods robust to DP.

feasibility_rules.condition: Steiger test indicates reverse direction for many IVs
feasibility_rules.action: WARN + offer Steiger filtering / bidirectional methods

feasibility_rules.condition: estimated sample overlap > 0 (LDSC intercept or shared cohorts) and overlap_handling starts with assumes_none
feasibility_rules.action: WARN + RECOMMEND MRlap / MR-APSS / MR-SimSS / CAUSE
feasibility_rules.message: Sample overlap can bias toward the observational association.
Estimate is per unit log-odds of exposure; ×0.693 gives per doubling of odds. Interpret via underlying continuous liability.

feasibility_rules.condition: LD matrix not positive-definite / LD–GWAS mismatch

feasibility_rules.message: Expected long runtime; runs in background with progress.

feasibility_rules.action: CHECK dependency installed; else BLOCK with install hint

version: 3.1 (2026-10-29: individual-level methods marked out of scope; v1 function updates)
